item.title: Fawzi Abu Rous, MD
item.description: Fawzi Abu Rous, MD, is a thoracic medical oncologist at Henry Ford Health. Dr. Rous conducts research on lung cancer, specializing in biomarker development. He also leads and designs clinical trials for lung cancer treatment.

item.title: Leah Phillips
item.description: Leah Phillips, a stage IV lung cancer patient and advocate, is the cofounder and executive director of the Young Lung Cancer Initiative, a community to support, uplift, and remember young adults with lung cancer.

item.title: Scott S. Oh, DO
item.description: Scott S. Oh, DO, is professor of clinical medicine, director of the interventional pulmonology quality and outcomes program, and director of the interventional pulmonology fellowship program at the Keck School of Medicine of USC.

item.title: Jessica Donington, MD
item.description: Jessica Donington, MD, is the chief of thoracic surgery at the University of Chicago. She specializes in non-small cell lung cancer.

item.title: Community Oncology Alliance
item.description: Serving as the voice of community oncology in Washington, DC, and across the country, the Community Oncology Alliance (COA) aims to improve patient care, offer professional growth for cancer care providers, and support practice operations. item.title: FDA Approves Monthly Amivantamab in EGFR-Mutated NSCLC
item.description: The FDA approved a once-monthly dosing schedule for amivantamab and hyaluronidase-lpuj plus daily lazertinib for advanced EGFR-mutated non-small cell lung cancer.

item.title: Female Cancer Survivors’ Sexual Health Largely Ignored
item.description: Women who survive cancer are not getting the sexual healthcare they need, according to a new review. The researchers suggest that oncologists are not having necessary conversations.

item.title: Oncologists Say Study Exposes “Stunning” Payer Problem
item.description: For oncologists navigating payer barriers, a new study revealed that nearly half of appealed denials are overturned. Learn more about what this means for cancer care.

item.title: Immunotherapy Combo Fails in Phase 3 SCLC Trial
item.description: Atezolizumab plus chemoradiation did not improve survival in limited-stage small cell lung cancer; however, the negative findings provide clarity on various issues.
